html.body: Date: 2025-04-29 REMARKSClaims 21-39 are pending in this Application, of which claims 21 and 31 are independent claims, and claims 22-30 and 32-39 are dependent claims, depending from independent claims 21 and 31. Claims 1-20 were previously canceled. As indicated in the Notice, all of claims 21-39 are allowed.Upon receipt of the Notice, Applicant reviewed the claims and noted certain minor changes that may be needed in some of the claims. Applicant is making these changes in this correspondence, and the Examiner is kindly requested to enter the claim amendments prior to issuance of the patent for this Application. In this regard, Applicant respectfully requests entry of these claim amendments pursuant to Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) § 714.16, submitting that the amendments to the claims address formal matters without changing the scope thereof. Applicant submits that the claim amendments require no substantial amount of additional work on the part of the United States Patent and Trademark Office ("Patent Office") as these changes do not add to or otherwise change the scope of the allowed subject matter(s).In this regard, Applicant submits that claims 22, 27, 28, and 32 are amended for clarification, consistency, and/or to address potential antecedent issues. In particular, claims 22, 27, 28, and 32 are amended to add "the" article before already-recited claim terms. Further, claims 22 and 32 are amended to correct minor grammatical errors therein namely, deleting unnecessary "and" recited therein.Applicant submits again that these changes do not add to or otherwise change the scope of the allowed subject matter(s).CONCLUSIONBased on at least the foregoing, Applicant believes that all claims remain in condition for allowance. Should there be any questions or if Applicant can be of any assistance, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney.The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees or credit any overpayment to the deposit account of McAndrews, Held & Malloy, Ltd., Account No.13-0017.Respectfully submitted, Date: Apr. 29, 2025 /Rami N.
